item.title: Vallejo police commission looks to ease complaint process
item.description: After three years of delay, Vallejo’s Police Oversight and Accountability Commission is finally functioning, electing a chair and vice-chair, establishing a regular meeting schedule and working to make it easier to file a complaint about the police. The commission had its first two formal meetings Jan. 12 and Feb. 2, unanimously electing John Lewis as chair and Renee Sykes as vice-chair. item.title: Prep Boys Basketball Playoffs: Second half dooms ELITE
item.description: The fans at ELITE High School’s gym had plenty to cheer about in the first half of Friday night’s boys basketball playoff game. The Eagles had used a 9-0 run to take a lead at the half. Everything seemed right in the world for the Eagles. Then the script flipped. item.title: Mare Island Logo repainted
item.description: After being taken down late last year, the Mare Island Logo has been repainted. The historic 600-pound logo came down in October for refurbishment and a new paint job. Jerry Hutchinson is the original painter of the redesigned logo, which was installed in May 1980 on the Ernest Wichels Causeway Bridge. item.title: Prep girls soccer: Vacaville shuts down Rocklin for first-ever section title
item.description: The fourth-seeded Bulldogs used a lockdown defensive effort to blank second-seeded Rocklin 2-0 in the Sac-Joaquin Section Division II championship game and capture the program’s first-ever section title.
